body:
# Truefuly's Crystal Optimizer **The fastest current End Crystal optimizer for Fabric** Minecraft 1.21.1 – 26.2 · Client + Server
--- ## Overview A lightweight mod that makes **End Crystal PvP feel clean and responsive**. It streamlines crystal placing and breaking for faster, more consistent combat — without changing vanilla mechanics or costing FPS. Currently one of the **fastest crystal optimizers available**. ## Features - ⚡ Optimized crystal placement & breaking - 🚀 Fastest current crystal optimizer on Fabric - 📶 Ping-aware packet limiter for stable, fair hits - 🪶 Lightweight — no bloat, no FPS cost - 🎚️ Instant in-game toggle (no restart) - 🛡️ Built-in server-side opt-out ## Usage Enable or disable anytime with `/truefulysoptimizer enable` or `/truefulysoptimizer disable`. ## For Server Owners Install the mod on your server and edit `config/truefulys_optimizer_server.json` — set `"allowCrystalOptimizer": true` to allow it, or `false` to disable it for everyone (default). ## Compatibility **MC:** 1.21.1 – 26.2 · **Loader:** Fabric · **Requires:** Fabric API
